cues.zhText: 顺着由浅入深的脉络，急性阑尾炎常分为急性单纯性阑尾炎、急性化脓性阑尾炎和急性坏疽性阑尾炎，但并非每位患者都按序走完全程。
cues.enText: From superficial to transmural, acute appendicitis is classified into acute simple, acute suppurative, and acute gangrenous appendicitis, though not every patient follows this exact sequence.

cues.zhText: 早期急性单纯性阑尾炎局限于黏膜和黏膜下层伴浅表糜烂，肌层与浆膜层仅见轻度水肿及少量中性粒细胞浸润，渗出详细过程见前。
cues.enText: Early acute simple appendicitis stays within the mucosa and submucosa with superficial erosion, showing only mild edema and sparse neutrophil infiltration in the muscularis and serosa.

cues.zhText: 进展为急性化脓性阑尾炎时，管壁张力骤增压迫阑尾壁动脉，并合并阑尾系膜静脉血栓，动静脉双重受阻，致阑尾缺血坏死。
cues.enText: In acute suppurative appendicitis, rising wall tension compresses mural arteries while mesoappendiceal vein thrombosis forms—dual vascular obstruction causing ischemia and necrosis.

cues.zhText: 坏死基础上继发腐败菌感染形成坏疽，阑尾才变黑成为急性坏疽性阑尾炎；坏疽常伴穿孔致弥漫性腹膜炎，但穿孔不一定伴有坏疽，急性化脓性阑尾炎也可直接破溃穿孔，二者不能画等号。
cues.enText: Secondary putrefactive infection of necrotic tissue produces black acute gangrenous appendicitis. Gangrene often leads to perforation and diffuse peritonitis, yet perforation does not require gangrene—acute suppurative appendicitis can also rupture directly.
